name: codeViewer
description:
## Conversation Summary

1. **`CodeViewer` edit mode** was added using a Monaco `Editor` component, allowing users to edit code blocks in-place with a toggle between plain editor and diff preview modes.

2. **Two distinct save actions** were established: `message-change` updates the chat message as a living document (no disk write), while `save-file` exclusively writes content to disk via the floppy disk icon.

3. **`Code.vue`** was updated to intercept `message-change` from `CodeViewer`, patch its local `codeText`, and emit `text-changed` upward carrying the updated block reference.

4. **`Markdown.vue`** was updated to own a mutable `localText` copy, surgically replace the matching fenced code block when a child `Code` component reports a change, re-render the HTML, and bubble `text-changed` to the parent.

5. **The full event chain** flows: `CodeViewer → message-change → Code.vue → text-changed → Markdown.vue → text-changed → ChatEntry/parent` enabling the message to act as an editable document without coupling disk saves to message edits.

The code and diff editor will emit a "message-change" not a "save" change. The message change will update the message content and save the chat, only the "save" icon will save content to the file. In this way the message acts as document that the use can edit.

When codeviewer emit code change we must populate until the markdown component where it will update the block content with the new changes.
From the blocks will regenerate a new "text" and emit "text-changed".
